input.summary: The freshness alert on raw.payments was a false positive. Commit 6a0e53d (the "SLA review" change) set the monitor's allowed lag to 0 days, so it expected the 2026-10-22 partition today. Under the Keel contract, that file isn't due until 05:00 on 2026-10-23. The 2026-10-21 partition is loaded at normal volume and the DAG run succeeded. I reverted the commit, which puts the allowed lag back to 1 day, and closed the alert. No data action was needed.
